name: @vidyam/ai
description: Turborepo wrapper for the Python AI engine; every script runs through uv.

scripts.lint: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --frozen ruff format . && uv run --frozen ruff check --fix .
scripts.codegen: uv run --frozen datamodel-codegen --input ../../packages/contracts/generated/json-schema/contracts.schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output src/vidyam_ai/generated/contracts.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.12 --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --use-double-quotes --field-constraints --snake-case-field --allow-population-by-field-name --use-schema-description --disable-timestamp --custom-file-header-path codegen-header.txt
